item.title: Air Fryer Chicken Burritos
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Chicken breast - 600g
  • Rice - 2 cups cooked
  • Tortillas - 4
  • Cheese - 1 cup
  • Beans - 1 can
  • Salsa - 1/2 cup
  • Seasoning
    • Salt
    • Pepper
    • Paprika

Directions

  1. Cook and season chicken, then shred
  2. Mix with rice, beans and salsa
  3. Fill tortillas and roll tightly
  4. Air fry at 190°C for 10–12 mins until crispy

Macros

  • Calories - 610
  • Protein - 48g
  • Carbs - 55g
  • Fat - 20g

item.title: Air Fryer Nachos
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Tortilla chips - 150–200g
  • Cheese - 1.5–2 cups (cheddar or blend)
  • Sweet corn - 1/2 cup
  • Bell peppers - 1 cup (chopped)
  • Onion - 1/2 (diced)
  • Jalapeños (optional)

Seasoning

  • Oregano
  • Chilli flakes
  • Salt (optional)

Optional Add-ons

  • Cooked beef or chicken
  • Beans
  • Sour cream
  • Guacamole
  • Salsa

Directions

  1. Line air fryer basket with parchment paper
  2. Add a layer of tortilla chips
  3. Top with vegetables, corn, and cheese
  4. Repeat layers if needed (chips → toppings → cheese)
  5. Sprinkle oregano and chilli flakes
  6. Air fry at 180°C for 5–7 minutes until cheese melts
  7. Remove and add optional toppings (sour cream, salsa, etc.)
  8. Serve immediately

Macros

  • Calories - 520
  • Protein - 18g
  • Carbs - 45g
  • Fat - 30g

Notes

  • Confirmed structure from reel + standard air fryer method :contentReference[oaicite:2]{index=2}
  • Best eaten fresh — chips soften quickly after cooking :contentReference[oaicite:3]{index=3}
  • Easily adaptable with added protein for a full meal

item.title: Big Mac Toastie
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Bread slices - 4
  • Ground beef - 300g
  • Cheese - 4 slices
  • Pickles - to taste
  • Onion - 1/4 (finely diced)
  • Lettuce - 1 cup (shredded)
  • Butter - 1 tbsp

Big Mac Sauce

  • Mayonnaise - 3 tbsp
  • Ketchup - 1 tbsp
  • Mustard - 1 tsp
  • Pickle juice - 1 tsp
  • Paprika - pinch

Directions

  1. Cook ground beef in a pan, breaking it up and seasoning with salt and pepper
  2. Mix all Big Mac sauce ingredients in a small bowl
  3. Butter the outside of the bread slices
  4. On the inside, layer beef, cheese, pickles, onion, lettuce and sauce
  5. Close sandwich and cook in a pan or sandwich press until golden and crispy
  6. Slice and serve

Macros

  • Calories - 680
  • Protein - 38g
  • Carbs - 42g
  • Fat - 38g

Notes

  • Corrected from previous misclassification (was incorrectly labelled as a chicken wrap)
  • Classic fast-food style toastie — high calorie, high fat

item.title: Cheese Pull Apart Bread
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Bread loaf (sourdough or cob) - 1
  • Mozzarella - 200g (cubed or shredded)
  • Butter - 3 tbsp (melted)
  • Garlic - 2 cloves (minced)
  • Parsley (optional)
  • Seasoning
    • Salt
    • Pepper

Directions

  1. Cut the bread in a crosshatch pattern (do not slice all the way through)
  2. Stuff mozzarella into the cuts throughout the loaf
  3. Mix melted butter with garlic and seasoning
  4. Pour or brush mixture over the bread, ensuring it gets into the gaps
  5. Wrap loosely in foil and bake at 180°C for 15 minutes
  6. Uncover and bake another 5–10 minutes until crispy and melted
  7. Serve immediately and pull apart

Macros

  • Calories - 420
  • Protein - 14g
  • Carbs - 38g
  • Fat - 24g

Notes

  • Identified based on “cheese pull” style construction
  • Designed for visual melt/stretch rather than high-protein efficiency
  • Best served immediately while cheese is hot and elastic

item.title: Chicken & Chorizo One Pan Rice
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Chicken breast - 600g (diced)
  • Chorizo - 120–150g (sliced)
  • Rice - 250–300g (uncooked, rinsed)
  • Onion - 1 (diced)
  • Red and yellow peppers - 2 (chopped)
  • Garlic - 3 cloves (minced)
  • Chicken stock - 500–700ml
  • Tomato paste - 2 tbsp
  • Oil - 1 tbsp

Seasoning

  • Smoked paprika - 2 tsp
  • Garlic powder - 1 tsp
  • Salt
  • Pepper
  • Chilli (optional)

Directions

  1. Heat oil in a large pan and cook chorizo until it releases oils
  2. Add onion, peppers, and garlic, cooking until softened
  3. Add chicken and cook until browned
  4. Stir in tomato paste and seasoning
  5. Add rice and mix to coat in flavours
  6. Pour in chicken stock and bring to a simmer
  7. Cover and cook for 15–20 minutes until rice is tender and liquid absorbed
  8. Fluff and serve

Macros

  • Calories - 600
  • Protein - 45g
  • Carbs - 60g
  • Fat - 18g

Notes

  • Confirmed from indexed reel + multiple matching recipes :contentReference[oaicite:4]{index=4}
  • Similar to simplified paella-style cooking (one-pan absorption method)
  • Very strong meal prep option

item.title: Chicken Alfredo Tortellini
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Chicken breast - 1 lb
  • Butter - 2 tbsp
  • Garlic - 1 tbsp minced
  • Frozen tortellini - 19 oz bag
  • Alfredo sauce - 15 oz jar
  • Mozzarella - 1 1/2 cups shredded
  • Bacon - 6 pieces
  • Seasoning
    • Salt
    • Pepper
    • Onion powder
    • Paprika
    • Italian seasoning

Directions

  1. Cook the bacon until crisp, then set aside
  2. Season the chicken and cook in the butter until browned and cooked through
  3. Add the garlic and cook briefly until fragrant
  4. Add the frozen tortellini and Alfredo sauce and stir to combine
  5. Simmer until the tortellini is cooked through
  6. Stir through the mozzarella until melted
  7. Crumble the bacon over the top and serve

Macros

Notes

item.title: Chicken Gnocchi Soup
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Chicken breast - 500g
  • Tomato puree - 3 tbsp
  • Sun dried tomatoes - 6 (chopped)
  • Chicken stock - 1L
  • Natural yogurt - 500g
  • Parmesan - 50g (grated)
  • Gnocchi - 400g
  • Spinach - 1 handful
  • Seasoning
    • Salt
    • Pepper

Directions

  1. Cook the chicken in a pot until lightly browned, then remove and chop if needed
  2. Add the tomato puree and sun dried tomatoes and cook briefly
  3. Pour in the chicken stock and bring to a simmer
  4. Add the gnocchi and cook until tender
  5. Lower the heat and stir through the yogurt and Parmesan
  6. Return the chicken to the pot and add the spinach
  7. Simmer gently until the spinach wilts and the soup is hot throughout
  8. Serve hot

Macros

  • Calories - 490 per serving
  • Protein - 52g
  • Carbs - 48g
  • Fat - 10g

Notes

item.title: Feta Fried Egg Tortilla
item.description:

  • Feta cheese - 2 tbsp (crumbled)

item.title: Giant Chicken Poppers
item.description:

Directions

  1. Mix chicken mince with seasonings in a large glass bowl
  2. Cover a piece of cheese with mince mix and roll into a ball
  3. Make more balls with cheese in the middle until the mince is gone
  4. Place the balls into the freezer for 30-60 minutes
  5. Blend the cornflakes with additional seasoning
  6. Roll the chicken balls in Greek yogurt
  7. Roll the chicken balls in the cornflake and seasoning mix

item.title: Hash Brown Feta Bites
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Flour or breadcrumbs - 2 tbsp (optional, for binding)
  • Oil spray or drizzle
  • Seasoning
    • Salt
    • Pepper
    • Garlic powder
    • Paprika

Directions

  1. If using frozen hash browns, thaw slightly
  2. Mix hash browns with egg, seasoning, and optional binder
  3. Form small portions and press feta into the centre (or mix feta through)
  4. Shape into balls or patties
  5. Place on a lined tray and lightly spray with oil
  6. Bake at 200°C for 20–25 minutes, flipping halfway, until crispy
  7. Serve hot

Macros

  • Carbs - 30g
  • Fat - 20g

Notes

item.title: Hash Brown, Halloumi & Chorizo Hash
item.description:

Seasoning

Directions

  2. In the same pan, cook chorizo until it releases oils and crisps
  3. Add onion and garlic, cooking until softened
  4. Add halloumi and cook until golden on all sides
  5. Return hash browns to the pan and mix everything together
  6. Create small wells and crack eggs into the pan
  7. Cover and cook until eggs reach desired doneness
  8. Serve hot

Macros

item.title: High Protein Chicken Katsu Fried Rice
item.description:
Ingredients

Chicken Katsu

  • Chicken breast - 600g (sliced or cubed)
  • Egg - 1
  • Cornflakes or panko breadcrumbs - 80g
  • Oil spray
  • Seasoning
    • Salt
    • Pepper

Fried Rice

  • Eggs - 2
  • Garlic - 2–3 cloves (minced)

  4. Fry garlic in oil until fragrant
  5. Add rice, vegetables, and soy sauce, stirring well
  6. Return eggs and mix through
  7. Slice crispy chicken katsu and place over fried rice
  8. Serve hot

Macros

  • Carbs - 60g

Notes

item.title: High Protein Crispy Honey Garlic Chicken Fried Rice
item.description:
Ingredients

Chicken

  • Diced boneless & skinless chicken breast - 1.05kg (raw weight)
  • Salt reduced soy sauce - 35ml
  • Garlic - 2 cloves (minced)
  • Potato starch - 100g
    • Approx. 40g adheres to chicken
  • Seasoning
    • Black pepper - 1/2 tsp
    • Onion powder - 1 tsp
    • Garlic powder - 1 tsp

Fried Rice

  • Frozen mixed vegetables - 500g
  • Eggs - 4
  • Egg whites - 200g
    • Or 5 whole eggs total
  • Spring onion / scallions (white part only) - 30g
  • Day old cooked white rice - 980g
  • Salt reduced soy sauce - 40ml
  • Spring onion / scallions (green part only) - 20g

Honey Garlic Sauce

  • Garlic - 5 cloves (minced)
  • Salt reduced soy sauce - 60ml
  • Water - 60ml
  • Reduced sugar ketchup - 100g
  • Rice wine vinegar - 25ml
  • Cornflour - 1 tsp
  • Water - 80ml
  • Honey - 80g

Directions

  1. Place diced chicken in a bowl and combine with 35ml soy sauce, minced garlic, black pepper, onion powder and garlic powder
  2. Coat chicken with potato starch until evenly covered
  3. Cook chicken until crispy and cooked through (oven or air fryer)
  4. Prepare honey garlic sauce by combining garlic, soy sauce, water, ketchup, rice wine vinegar, cornflour slurry and honey
  5. Heat sauce gently until thickened
  6. In a large pan or tray, cook mixed vegetables with the white parts of the spring onion
  7. Add eggs and egg whites and cook until scrambled
  8. Add day-old rice and 40ml soy sauce, mixing thoroughly
  9. Fold through crispy chicken and green spring onion
  10. Pour over honey garlic sauce and mix until evenly coated
  11. Portion into 7 servings and serve

Notes

  • Caption-faithful reconstruction from reel ingredients
  • Uses potato starch to create crispy chicken coating
  • Day-old rice improves texture and prevents clumping
  • Designed as a high-protein meal prep recipe

item.title: High Protein Honey BBQ Chicken Mac & Cheese

item.title: No-Bake Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough Bars
item.description:
Ingredients

Cookie Dough Base

  • Butter - 1/2 cup (softened)
  • Brown sugar - 3/4 cup
  • Vanilla extract - 1 tsp
  • Milk - 1/3 cup
  • Flour (heat-treated or oat flour) - 2 cups
  • Salt - pinch
  • Chocolate chips - 1 cup

Chocolate Topping

  • Chocolate chips - 1/2 cup
  • Butter or coconut oil - 1 tbsp

Directions

  1. In a bowl, mix softened butter and brown sugar until smooth
  2. Add vanilla and milk, mixing well
  3. Stir in flour and salt until a dough forms
  4. Fold in chocolate chips
  5. Press mixture evenly into a lined baking dish
  6. Melt chocolate and butter together until smooth
  7. Pour chocolate over the top and spread evenly
  8. Refrigerate for 1–2 hours until firm
  9. Slice into bars and serve

Macros

  • Calories - 420
  • Protein - 5g
  • Carbs - 45g
  • Fat - 24g

Notes

  • No-bake and egg-free → safe-to-eat cookie dough style :contentReference[oaicite:2]{index=2}
  • Chill time is essential for firm texture
  • Can substitute oat/almond flour for a healthier version
